fullDaySay: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a limp returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with calloused knuckles returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A woman, maybe 30s, with calloused knuckles eats quiet by the fire, scraping the bowl clean with their thumb.
"Hey." A woman, maybe 60s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 60s.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
A man, maybe 50s is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 73/100)
A person, maybe 30s, with a limp came back with 775 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Quinn and Duy lingered over the fire together.
Yuki and Quinn lingered over the fire together.

You remember the Flannel Shirt at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

🔥 Yara has been turning something over all evening. Finally: “Arlo. The past story — we all eat from the same pot here, we don’t get to lie about who’s at it.” It costs Yara to say it; you can see the price land.
Nora Kamara reads the sky: frost tomorrow, cold.
A person, maybe 30s, with a limp will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A woman, maybe 60s — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a limp — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Arlo," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Arlo." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Arlo).
...and then it lands: A person, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Duy," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Duy." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Duy).
"Nora," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Nora." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Nora).

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
Water over stone, loud enough to cover your noise. You could drink here without announcing it.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
✅ You saw the creek. Arlo nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)

You catch fragments by the fire — Arlo telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.

You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 40s, with a wiry build telling A woman, maybe 30s, with restless hands about A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — Greta telling Arlo about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
Mast crunches underfoot — last season's nuts, sprouting or rotting. The trees don't waste anything.
Movement — a big brown bat cutting arcs through the dusk.
👁 It hears you coming mid-wingbeat — in the air, you don't catch it. Hunt it roosting at dawn, or wait for the water it must come down to.
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
You also take some vine (crafting material).
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.

A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 3× unknown berries, 3× unknown berries. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
Nora picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)

A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame spends the afternoon with the thorny bush with dark berries — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Blackberry — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Blackberry. Thorny canes, dark berries. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 You see it again in your mind: a thorny bush with dark berries. A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame's words land on the memory like a label. Blackberry. Of course.
A woman, maybe 20s was watching. Now they know Blackberry too.

A woman, maybe 30s, with calloused knuckles came back with 420 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 210 kcal in, 210 kcal eaten at the fire.

🔧 Technique learned: tick removal.
A person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)
